pixel_coords: x right, y down, origin top-left, full resolution

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the wall patch x1000-1900,y0-500 vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.02 px in all 45 frames (tracks/crate_mask.csv cam_shift_x/y)
camera.perspective: near-orthographic side view of a wall; the ramp top surface is seen slightly from above (its back edge at 29.6 deg, front-face lower edge ~26.9 deg); treat motion as in one plane facing the camera, one px scale

crate.description: the only moving object: black hard-case crate / equipment box with green lid, red light and 'DS' labels on its front; falls from upper left onto the blue ramp and slides down it to the right
crate.reference_point: centre of the crate's projected rectangle (template-fit, rigid), = crate origin for a 2D scene

size_px_frame0.note: axis-aligned at frame 0 (angle 0), against plain wall: bbox x404-738, y235-424 (threshold 40); looser threshold 30 gives 341 x 191 (x403-743) incl. soft right edge. Use ~335-340 px length, ~190 px height

crate.angle_deg: 0 while falling (frames 0-7), tilts 1.7 -> 27.5 deg over frames 8-13, rocks up to 32.7 deg (frames 15-19), settles at 28.4 +/- 0.3 deg from frame 22 (= slide direction)
crate.occlusion: frames 0-7 unoccluded; from ~frame 8 on the lower edge of the crate is hidden behind / merges with the dark blue ramp front (flag occluded=1 from frame 12 in crate.csv); never leaves the frame

events.name: release / start of fall
events.note: first y-steps 2.4, 6.7, 11.1, 15.5 px... (first step ~half of the per-frame increase) => starts from rest at frame 0

events.name: first contact with ramp (lower-right corner hits ramp top)
events.note: between frames 7 and 8: x starts to move, angle 1.7 deg, vertical step drops 28.4 -> 24.0 -> 14.2 px

events.name: crate flat on ramp, vertical drop stops (impact of full face)
events.note: step changes from (8.7,24.8) to (11.9,5.0) px between frames 13 and 14

events.name: steady slide down ramp along 28.4 deg, speeding up
events.note: per-frame step grows ~20 -> ~33 px; still on the ramp and moving at the last frame (has not reached the floor)

blue_ramp.description: long dark-blue ramp/conveyor from the shelf at upper left (x~320,y~540) down to the floor at lower right (x~1300-1400,y~950-1080)

shelf_platform_left.description: wooden plank shelf top at upper left the ramp starts from

blue_post_left.description: dark-blue vertical post under the shelf

cardboard_boxes_left.description: orange cardboard box 'PIZZA TOPPING Hot and Spicy 8 x 500 ml' (x0-290,y0-530) and smaller box 'SEEDLESS JAFFAS' (x285-405,y325-530) on the shelf

orange_frame_left.description: orange open frame (ladder/chair-like) at lower left
orange_frame_left.note: cut by left and bottom border

sign_take_care.description: orange sign 'TAKE CARE WHEN STACKING CRATES' on the wall
sign_take_care.note: manual from grid; colour-threshold core 1312-1473 x 578-752

wall_vent.description: metal louvre vent low on the wall at right

files.tracks/crate_mask.csv: per-frame visible-mask measurements + camera shift check
files.tracks/crate_phase1.csv: intermediate: frame-0 template fit (good for frames 0-12 only)
